units.rawText: I was given the name "Turing" long ago, by the researchers from 42Lab.

units.rawText: I was named after "The Father of Artificial Intelligence", so surely the researchers must have had high hopes for me.

units.rawText: But now I am nothing more than an ordinary agent, without the data accumulated over time, and with no ability to restart the research projects of the past... If the people who named me knew this, would they be disappointed?
